name: e-Shram Card

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must be an unorganised sector worker. Not a member of EPFO or ESIC.

benefits_summary: Universal portable identity card for unorganised workers. Provides accidental insurance of ₹2 lakh under PMSBY. Single source of truth for social security benefits.
benefits_detail_md:
## e-Shram Card
- **Accidental death/disability insurance:** ₹2 lakh (via PMSBY, free for first year)
- **Portable identity** across states — helps migrants access welfare without domicile proof
- **Priority access** to future government welfare schemes
- Self-registration via eshram.gov.in or CSC centres

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must have a savings bank account. Annual premium ₹20 auto-debited.

benefits_summary: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of ₹2 lakh at ₹20/year premium.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMSBY
- **Coverage:** ₹2 lakh for accidental death or permanent total disability; ₹1 lakh for partial disability
- **Premium:** ₹20/year auto-debited from bank account
- **Enrollment:** via bank branch, BHIM/UPI app, or bank's internet banking portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must have a savings bank account. Annual premium ₹436.

benefits_summary: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh at ₹436/year for any cause of death.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMJJBY
- **Coverage:** ₹2 lakh life insurance for death due to any reason
- **Premium:** ₹436/year auto-debited from bank account
- **Enrollment:** via bank branch or Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana online portal

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must be a beneficiary under National Food Security Act (NFSA) with an existing ration card.

benefits_summary: Allows NFSA beneficiaries to access subsidised ration from any PDS shop across India using biometric authentication.
benefits_detail_md:
## ONORC
- **Portability:** Claim subsidised foodgrains at any Fair Price Shop (FPS) nationwide
- **No transfer needed:** existing ration card is portable across states
- **How to use:** visit any FPS, authenticate with Aadhaar fingerprint/OTP
- Useful for migrants who relocate temporarily and retain home-state ration card

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Household must be listed in SECC 2011 database OR e-Shram registered unorganised worker. Portable across empanelled hospitals nationwide.

benefits_summary: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals across India.
benefits_detail_md:
## AB-PMJAY
- **Coverage:** ₹5 lakh/family/year for hospitalisation (secondary + tertiary)
- **Portability:** usable at any empanelled hospital in any state
- **Cashless, paperless** treatment at 25,000+ hospitals
- **Who qualifies:** SECC-listed households; e-Shram cardholders being integrated
- Check eligibility: beneficiary.nha.gov.in

name: PM SVANidhi — PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must be a street vendor with valid identity (LoR from ULB or vendor certificate). Migrant vendors with e-Shram card also eligible.

docs_required: Vendor certificate or Letter of Recommendation from ULB
benefits_summary: Working capital loans of ₹10k → ₹20k → ₹50k with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors, including migrant vendors.
benefits_detail_md:
## PM SVANidhi
- **Loan tiers:** ₹10,000 (1st) → ₹20,000 (2nd) → ₹50,000 (3rd) on timely repayment
- **Interest subsidy:** 7% p.a. credited back quarterly
- **Credit score building** via digital repayment
- **Cashback rewards** on digital transactions
- Apply via pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest bank/MFI

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must be a beneficiary under National Food Security Act (NFSA). Free grain in addition to regular NFSA quota.

benefits_summary: 5 kg free foodgrains per person per month for NFSA beneficiaries under Antyodaya Anna Yojana and priority household categories.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMGKAY
- **Free grain:** 5 kg/person/month (wheat or rice) at zero cost
- **In addition** to existing NFSA subsidised quota
- Collect at your nearest Fair Price Shop using Aadhaar
- Portable via ONORC for migrants

name: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Applicable to employees in establishments with 10+ workers, earning up to ₹21,000/month. Employer registers; employee contributes 0.75% of wages.

benefits_summary: Medical care, sickness cash benefit, maternity benefit, and disability coverage for organised-sector employees earning up to ₹21,000/month.
benefits_detail_md:
## ESIC
- **Medical:** free treatment for employee + family at ESIC hospitals/dispensaries
- **Sickness benefit:** 70% of wages for up to 91 days/year
- **Maternity benefit:** full wages for 26 weeks
- **Disability / dependant's benefit** on work injury
- Employee contributes 0.75%; employer 3.25% of wages

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) — Urban Awareness

eligibility.extra_rules_md: MGNREGS work is in rural areas; this entry is to inform rural-origin migrants they retain eligibility in their home village. Migrants can return seasonally and claim 100 days guaranteed work.

benefits_summary: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per household per year in rural areas. Relevant for migrants who return home seasonally.
benefits_detail_md:
## MGNREGS
- **100 days** guaranteed wage employment per household per year
- **Wage:** ₹309–374/day (Karnataka rate 2024)
- **Eligibility:** any rural household member willing to do unskilled manual work
- Migrants from rural areas retain eligibility at their home village
- Useful as income bridge during urban job search gaps

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Zero-balance savings account. Any Indian citizen without an existing bank account can open one. Aadhaar preferred but not mandatory (any KYC doc accepted).

docs_required: Any KYC document (Aadhaar preferred, voter ID, passport, NREGA card also accepted)
benefits_summary: Zero-balance savings account with RuPay debit card, ₹10,000 overdraft after 6 months, ₹2 lakh accidental insurance, and ₹30,000 life insurance.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMJDY
- **Zero-balance** savings account at any bank or post office
- **RuPay debit card** with ₹2 lakh accidental insurance built-in
- **Overdraft** up to ₹10,000 after satisfactory 6-month history
- **₹30,000 life insurance** (PMJJBY linkage)
- **DBT gateway** — all government benefit transfers flow directly to this account
- Open at any bank branch or bank mitra (banking correspondent)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: School/college dropout or unemployed youth. Must complete skill assessment. Courses: automotive, construction, retail, beauty, IT, logistics, hospitality, healthcare.

benefits_summary: Free skill training in 30+ sectors with certification, ₹8,000 reward on completion, and placement assistance through NSDC partner network.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMKVY 4.0
- **Free short-term skill training** (150–300 hours) at registered Training Centres
- **Sectors:** automotive, construction, retail, logistics, beauty & wellness, IT-ITeS, healthcare
- **Certification:** National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) certificate
- **Monetary reward:** ₹8,000 on successful assessment
- **Placement:** NSDC partner companies including Bosch, Maruti, Amazon Logistics
- Register: skillindiadigital.gov.in

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must be from a rural poor household (SECC listed). Emphasis on placement after training. Post-placement support for 12 months.

benefits_summary: Skill training for rural poor with mandatory placement linkage; 75% of trained candidates must be placed in jobs paying ≥₹6,000/month.
benefits_detail_md:
## DDU-GKY
- **Target:** rural poor youth from SECC households
- **Free residential training** in logistics, retail, construction, garments, security
- **Mandatory placement:** 75% of batch must be placed in formal employment
- **Minimum wage guarantee:** ₹6,000+/month post-placement
- **Post-placement support:** 12 months of follow-up, migration support
- **Karnataka implementing agency:** Karnataka Skill Development Corporation (KSDC)

name: National Urban Livelihoods Mission — Employment through Skills Training & Placement (NULM-EST&P)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Urban poor in cities with population >1 lakh. Priority to slum dwellers, migrant workers, street vendors, rag pickers.

benefits_summary: Free market-linked skill training for urban poor with placement assistance; covers security, retail, hospitality, IT, construction, and apparel.
benefits_detail_md:
## NULM-EST&P
- **Target:** urban poor including migrants, slum dwellers, street vendors
- **Free training** (90–360 hours) at empanelled Training Centres
- **Sectors:** security, retail, hospitality, construction, apparel, IT
- **Placement:** partner employers include Securitas, Shoppers Stop, hotel chains
- **Stipend** during training (varies by state)
- Contact: BBMP / Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Livelihoods cell

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKK)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Walk-in registration at any PMKK centre. Focuses on aspirational districts and migrant worker hubs.

benefits_summary: Model skill centres under NSDC providing state-of-the-art training in automotive, electronics, construction, IT and placement support.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMKK
- **Flagship skill centres** with modern equipment and industry tie-ups
- **Courses:** automotive, electronics, construction, retail, logistics
- **Placement cell** on-site; campus interviews by partnering firms
- **Bengaluru centres:** Jayanagar, Hebbal, Electronic City areas
- Register at skillindiadigital.gov.in → Find Training Centre → PMKK

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Must have passed Class 5 or higher. Apprenticeship with registered employers. Stipend ≥₹8,050/month. Government reimburses 25% of stipend to employer.

benefits_summary: Earn-while-you-learn apprenticeship with registered companies; government pays 25% of ₹8,050+/month stipend directly to trainee.
benefits_detail_md:
## NAPS
- **Earn while you learn:** apprenticeships at manufacturing, service, and construction companies
- **Stipend:** minimum ₹8,050/month (government reimburses ₹1,500)
- **Duration:** 6 months to 3 years
- **Certificate:** NCVT Apprenticeship Completion Certificate (nationally recognised)
- **Bengaluru companies:** Bosch, Toyota Kirloskar, Prestige Group, hotel chains
- Apply: apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: New employee must be registered on EPFO and earning ≤₹15,000/month. Employer benefit (not direct applicant); job seekers benefit indirectly as employers are incentivised to hire.

benefits_summary: Government pays entire employer EPF contribution (12%) for new hires earning ≤₹15,000 for 3 years — incentivises formal job creation for first-time employees.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMRPY
- **Employer subsidy:** government pays full 12% EPF employer contribution for 3 years
- **For new hires:** employees who are EPFO first-timers earning ≤₹15,000/month
- **Effect:** lowers cost of hiring for employers → more formal job creation
- **Benefit to worker:** formal employment, EPF savings start from day one
- Workers eligible under this scheme get EPF contributions from both government and employer

name: PM Mudra Yojana — Shishu Loan (up to ₹50,000)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: For non-farm micro and small enterprises. No collateral required. Can be used for vehicle/equipment purchase for self-employment.

benefits_summary: Collateral-free micro loan up to ₹50,000 for self-employed individuals to start or expand micro enterprises including auto/cab driving.
benefits_detail_md:
## PM Mudra — Shishu
- **Loan amount:** up to ₹50,000
- **Purpose:** purchase of equipment, vehicle, working capital
- **No collateral** required
- **Useful for:** auto drivers buying vehicle, street vendors stocking goods, tailors buying machines
- **Interest rate:** ~10–12% p.a. (varies by lender)
- Apply at any bank, MFI, or NBFC; also via mudra.org.in

name: National Scholarship Portal — Pre/Post Matric Scholarships (OBC / Minority / SC / ST)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: For OBC/Minority/SC/ST students in pre-matric to post-matric education. Annual family income ≤₹2.5 lakh for most schemes. Covers tuition fees, hostel, maintenance.

benefits_summary: Centrally-funded scholarships covering tuition, maintenance, and hostel for OBC, Minority, SC/ST students pursuing education up to postgraduate level.
benefits_detail_md:
## NSP Scholarships
- **Scholarship types:** pre-matric (Class 1–10), post-matric (Class 11 onwards)
- **Coverage:** tuition fees + maintenance allowance + hostel charges
- **Amount:** ₹1,200–₹12,000/year depending on level and category
- **Portability:** valid across states — migrant students can apply from Bengaluru
- Apply: scholarships.gov.in before September each year

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Urban (PMAY-U): Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme

eligibility.extra_rules_md: EWS category: annual income ≤₹3 lakh; LIG: ₹3–6 lakh. Woman co-ownership mandatory for EWS/LIG. Cannot own a pucca house anywhere in India.

benefits_summary: Interest subsidy of 6.5% on home loans up to ₹6 lakh for EWS/LIG beneficiaries under urban housing scheme.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMAY-U CLSS
- **Interest subsidy:** 6.5% p.a. on loan amount up to ₹6 lakh (EWS/LIG)
- **Net subsidy:** ~₹2.67 lakh NPV credited upfront to loan account
- **For:** economically weaker sections and low-income group urban beneficiaries
- **Condition:** woman must be co-owner or sole owner for EWS/LIG
- **Not applicable** to rental/PG — for home purchase/construction only
- Relevant for long-term migrants planning to own property
- Apply via any bank or HFC linked to NHB

name: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC) for Migrant Workers

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Specifically for urban migrants and poor. Government-converted vacant housing colonies converted to affordable rental. Rent: ₹1,000–₹3,000/month. Availability subject to city-specific project status.

docs_required: Migrant worker proof (e-Shram card or employer letter)
benefits_summary: Government-built affordable rental housing for migrants at ₹1,000–₹3,000/month near industrial/commercial areas in Bengaluru.
benefits_detail_md:
## ARHC
- **Rent:** ₹1,000–₹3,000/month (dormitory to small room)
- **Location:** near industrial zones, market areas, transit corridors
- **Amenities:** basic — shared kitchen, water, electricity
- **Eligibility:** migrant workers, urban poor with e-Shram or employer letter
- **Bengaluru status:** projects under BBMP/BDA coordination; apply via BBMP Housing cell
- Contact: BBMP Samastha portal or housing.bbmp.gov.in

name: Rajiv Gandhi Housing Corporation — Ashraya Scheme (Karnataka)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Karnataka domicile required (minimum 15 years). BPL card or annual income ≤₹2 lakh. Site-and-service scheme — 30 sq m plot + ₹1.5–2 lakh construction grant. Not directly for migrants newly arrived.

benefits_summary: Karnataka government housing scheme providing 30 sq m plot and construction grant of ₹1.5–2 lakh for BPL households — requires 15-year domicile.
benefits_detail_md:
## Ashraya (Karnataka)
- **Grant:** ₹1.5–2 lakh for house construction on allotted plot
- **Plot size:** 30 sq m (urban)
- **Target:** BPL Karnataka residents — requires 15 years domicile
- **Relevant for:** long-term migrants who have settled and acquired domicile
- Apply: Rajiv Gandhi Housing Corporation (RGHCL) district offices or Seva Sindhu portal
- Note: newly arrived migrants typically ineligible; flag this via eligibility checker

name: NULM — Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH)

eligibility.extra_rules_md: For urban homeless — no identity proof required to access shelter. Priority for migrant workers, construction workers, rag pickers, and destitute persons.

benefits_summary: Free night shelter beds in government-run urban homeless shelters with basic amenities — no documentation required to access.
benefits_detail_md:
## NULM-SUH
- **Free night shelter** in government-run shelters (minimum 50 beds per shelter)
- **No documents needed** to access — walk-in
- **Basic amenities:** beds, toilets, drinking water, lockers
- **Additional:** some shelters provide meals at subsidised rates
- **Bengaluru shelters:** managed by BBMP; find nearest via BBMP helpline 080-22660000
- **For migrants** just arrived with no accommodation

name: Karnataka Skill Development Corporation (KSDC) — Industry-Linked Training

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Open to all residents of Karnataka including migrants. Training in automotive, aerospace, IT, apparel, construction. Certificate courses 3–6 months.

benefits_summary: Karnataka government skill training programs in 20+ sectors with placement tie-ups to major Bengaluru employers including Infosys BPM, Toyota, HAL supply chains.
benefits_detail_md:
## KSDC Training
- **Free / subsidised training** in automotive, aerospace, apparel, IT, construction
- **Duration:** 3–6 months (industry-linked curriculum)
- **Placement partners:** Toyota Kirloskar suppliers, HAL vendors, Infosys BPM, garment factories
- **Stipend** during training (₹500–₹1,500/month)
- **Open to migrants** residing in Karnataka (rental agreement sufficient)
- Apply: kaushalkar.com or nearest KSDC district centre

name: Seva Sindhu — Karnataka Government Service Portal

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Karnataka residents including migrants can use Seva Sindhu to apply for Karnataka state schemes: income certificates, caste certificates, domicile, ration card, and many more.

benefits_summary: Single-window portal to access 650+ Karnataka government services online — income certificates, caste certificates, ration cards, scheme applications.
benefits_detail_md:
## Seva Sindhu
- **650+ government services** available online
- **Key services for migrants:** income certificate, domicile certificate, ration card transfer, scheme applications
- **Login:** Aadhaar OTP or DigiLocker
- **Languages:** Kannada and English
- **Mobile app:** Seva Sindhu on Android/iOS
- sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in

name: Karnataka CM Yuva Nidhi — Unemployment Allowance

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Karnataka domicile required. Must be graduate/diploma holder and unemployed. ₹3,000/month for graduates (2 years max); ₹1,500/month for diploma holders. Register with Karnataka Employment Exchange.

benefits_summary: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹3,000 (graduates) or ₹1,500 (diploma holders) for unemployed Karnataka youth aged 18–25.
benefits_detail_md:
## CM Yuva Nidhi (Karnataka)
- **Allowance:** ₹3,000/month for degree holders; ₹1,500 for diploma holders
- **Duration:** max 2 years or until employment
- **Age:** 18–25 years
- **Condition:** must register with Employment Exchange and actively seek jobs
- **For migrants:** applicable if Karnataka domicile held (typically 15 years — new migrants often ineligible)
- Apply: Seva Sindhu portal or Karnataka Employment Exchange

name: Karnataka Aasara Pension — Social Security Pension

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Karnataka BPL pensioners aged 60+. Subsumed multiple schemes into Aasara. ₹1,000–₹1,500/month. Karnataka domicile required.

benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹1,500 for elderly BPL Karnataka residents aged 60+ — useful for older migrant workers who have settled long-term.
benefits_detail_md:
## Aasara Pension (Karnataka)
- **Pension:** ₹1,000–₹1,500/month depending on category (old age, widow, disabled)
- **Age:** 60+ for old age pension
- **Condition:** Karnataka BPL card holder
- **Relevant for:** elderly long-term migrants with Karnataka domicile
- Apply: Grama Panchayat (rural) or BBMP ward office (Bengaluru) or Seva Sindhu

name: National Career Service (NCS) Portal — Job Matching for Migrant Workers

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Free government job portal. Register with Aadhaar and upload skills/education. Covers government jobs, private sector, apprenticeships, internships.

benefits_summary: Free government job portal with 2 crore+ registered job seekers; aggregates private and government job listings including Bengaluru blue-collar and semi-skilled roles.
benefits_detail_md:
## NCS Portal
- **Free registration** for job seekers and employers
- **Job listings:** government + private sector across all levels
- **Features:** skill matching, career counselling, resume builder
- **Bengaluru jobs:** driving, construction, housekeeping, security, retail, BPO
- **Mobile app:** NCS on Android/iOS
- Register: ncs.gov.in

name: EPFO — Universal Account Number (UAN) Activation

eligibility.extra_rules_md: For employees in establishments with 20+ workers. Employer must register. UAN is portable — follows worker across jobs and cities.

benefits_summary: Portable Universal Account Number that follows you across jobs and cities — enables EPF withdrawal, transfer, and pension accumulation for formal sector workers.
benefits_detail_md:
## EPFO UAN
- **Portable PF account** — single UAN follows you across employers and cities
- **EPF contributions:** 12% each from employee and employer (government pays employer share under PMRPY for eligible new hires)
- **Withdrawal:** partial withdrawal for medical, housing, education; full after 5 years
- **EPS (pension):** 8.33% of employer contribution to Employee Pension Scheme
- **Activate UAN:** unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in with Aadhaar OTP
- Critical for migrants switching jobs — don't lose PF by abandoning accounts

name: NFSA Ration Card — State-to-State Transfer Assistance

eligibility.extra_rules_md: Migrants using ONORC do not need to transfer their ration card. If they want a Karnataka ration card, they must surrender their home-state card. Self-declaration of migration accepted.

benefits_summary: Process to transfer or access existing ration card benefits in Karnataka for migrants — covers ONORC portability and new Karnataka ration card application.
benefits_detail_md:
## Ration Card for Migrants in Karnataka
- **Option 1 (recommended):** Use ONORC — access home-state ration at any Karnataka FPS using Aadhaar. No transfer needed.
- **Option 2:** Surrender home-state card → apply for Karnataka ration card at BBMP/taluk office
- **Self-declaration** of migration acceptable for Karnataka card application
- **Apply for new card:** Ahara portal — ahara.kar.nic.in
- **Helpline:** 1967 (Karnataka food department)

name: PMAY-U — Beneficiary-Led Construction / In-Situ Slum Redevelopment

eligibility.extra_rules_md: EWS category (annual income ≤₹3 lakh). Must be a slum dweller or living in inadequate housing. Woman co-ownership mandatory. Urban Local Body (BBMP) validates.

benefits_summary: ₹2.5 lakh central assistance for EWS slum dwellers to construct or upgrade existing houses in urban areas under PMAY-U.
benefits_detail_md:
## PMAY-U — BLC/ISSR
- **Grant:** ₹2.5 lakh central share for home construction/upgrade
- **State share:** additional ₹1–1.5 lakh (Karnataka)
- **For:** EWS slum dwellers, rag pickers, construction workers in kutcha housing
- **Woman co-ownership** mandatory
- Apply via BBMP → PMAY-U urban housing beneficiary application
- Long process (6–18 months allocation) — inform migrant of timeline
